description: This file manages drag-and-drop operations within a test project tree for the TestLink open source project. It handles actions such as changing parent nodes and reordering nodes via server-side PHP functions, triggered by JavaScript functions in the frontend.

classes.description: A class instantiated to manage tree operations such as changing parent nodes and reordering nodes.
